body.notes: CORRECTION + STATE 2026-09-08. Cards 1188-1194 APPLIED and verified in the live DOM: all 6 CCOHS citations render, colour rgb(1,122,18) = #017A12 as intended, queue empty. BUT two things I got wrong. (1) My premise 'zero authority citations on all 6 category pages' came from pre-publish-check and was WRONG. Pre-edit exports show 45=wikipedia x2, 39=cummins x2 + recyclingcouncil.ca + bdc.ca, 43=wikipedia x2 + bdc.ca, 41=honda x2 + hydro-gear + ccohs.ca, 37=honda x2 + landscapeontario.com, 47=wikipedia x4 + boschrexroth. So 4 of 6 already had authority-grade or industry sources. Page 41 ALREADY cited CCOHS on the same manual-material-handling point, inside an ACCORDION FAQ item, so my card 1193 is redundant there. (2) Root cause of my bad premise: class-link-audit.php classify_link credits only TLD gov, TLD edu, or an exact host in cc_assistant_authority_domains (US health/science defaults). Canadian federal domains are .gc.ca/.ca and never .gov, so ccohs.ca, bdc.ca, canada.ca all classify 'unclassified' and authority_links reports 0 even with real citations live. authority_links is STRUCTURALLY UNPASSABLE on a Canadian site. Attempt to widen the whitelist via /draft/plugin-setting was REFUSED 403 option_protected (plugin-internal). So this is a PLUGIN CODE fix, not a site fix: widen classify_link to accept gc.ca and Canadian federal/provincial hosts, and/or extend the shipped defaults in class-activator.php. Affects every non-US client site. (3) My duplicate-guard bug worth remembering: I checked only the widget being edited and did not recurse into LIST-valued settings, which is where elementskit accordion FAQ items live. Page-wide + list-recursive check next time. TOOL FIX SHIPPED: D:/cc-assistant/tools/cc-via-browser.mjs now clears 'lockfile' alongside SingletonLock/Cookie/Socket. Windows Chrome uses 'lockfile' and it was never cleared, so any killed run bricked every later launch with a bare Chrome error. Verified working. NEXT CANDIDATES: remove redundant card on 41; swap 8 WIKIPEDIA links (45,43,47) for manufacturer sources and normalise their #01B51B to #017A12; normalise guide citation links off the failing #01B51B (2.75:1); build the concrete-buggy and skid-steer-attachments commercial pages (real demand, zero clicks, no page); author bio for user id 2 is an operator wp-admin task.
